justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces present anthropomorphic imagery rendered non-naturalistically, plus incidental rounded/linear motifs, which is about as generic as a correspondence can be. A shows one large frontal body with relief motifs (hands, discs, belt-like bands, curvilinear scrolls) arranged over the torso, whereas B shows a scattered horizontal row of tiny stick-figure humans and a branching sign across an open panel, with no shared specific motif, relationship or layout.
